main.description: Start a multipart video upload. The declared size is exact, while optional media properties are advisory and used only for early failure; the authoritative probe runs asynchronously after upload.

durationMs.description: Advisory, non-authoritative duration used only for early failure; the authoritative probe runs asynchronously after upload.

height.description: Advisory, non-authoritative height used only for early failure; the authoritative probe runs asynchronously after upload.

mimeType.description: Declared MIME type of the video.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the complete upload-ready video file before it is split into parts.

width.description: Advisory, non-authoritative width used only for early failure; the authoritative probe runs asynchronously after upload.

errors.description: The declared MIME type is not supported.
errors.name: UnsupportedContentType

errors.description: The exact file size exceeds the per-file cap or remaining daily byte allowance.
errors.name: VideoTooLarge

errors.description: The advisory declared duration exceeds the limit.
errors.name: VideoTooLong

errors.description: The advisory declared dimensions have an unsupported aspect ratio.
errors.name: BadAspectRatio

errors.description: The daily video or byte allowance, including active reservations, is exhausted.
errors.name: DailyLimitExceeded

errors.description: The account has reached its open multipart upload limit.
errors.name: TooManyOpenUploads

errors.description: The account is not permitted to upload video.
errors.name: UploadForbidden

errors.description: The service is draining, at capacity, or temporarily unable to create the multipart upload.
errors.name: ServiceOverloaded
